from pydantic import BaseModel, Field

class JudgmentDocument(BaseModel):
    """A single judgment document found in the input."""
    title: str | None = Field(description="The title of the judgment document")
    document_type: str | None = Field(description="The type of document (e.g., 判决书，裁定书，通知书)")
    stated_cause_of_action: str | None = Field(description="The cause of action (案由) explicitly stated in the document")

class Parse(BaseModel):
    documents: list[JudgmentDocument]
